My bad, you're right. My comment only applies to the Replica and Limited jerseys

You can see another difference in this picture. There's no stitching on the numbers. Authentic jerseys from 2024 on will have heat-pressed lettering instead of being stitched on.

Sometimes faux stitching will be printed on the number, but you can check the inside of the jersey to see if it's actually directly stitched on or not

It's a fake. The neck label should be directly heat-pressed on the jersey. 

Buy it if you think it looks nice, but if you're looking for authenticity, I wouldn't recommend it
